entities.summary: Aleksandar Antić is a Serbian politician. He served as the Minister of Energy and Mining between 2014 and 2020. Antić previously served as the Minister of Transportation from 2013 to 2014. He is a member of the Socialist Party of Serbia. Aleksandar Antić was a performers & entertainers from Belgrade (b. 1969-05-07, Belgrade). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
